title.en: The State government and the citizen

text.en:
Asha's mother went to the district office to get a certificate.
"This office belongs to the State government," she said.

India has a Union government at the centre and a State government in each state. The Chief Minister heads the State government and the Governor is the formal head of the state.
State governments look after matters such as police, health, agriculture and local schools. The state legislature, called the Vidhan Sabha, makes laws.
Citizens deal with the government through offices, panchayats and online services.

prompt.en: A friend says the Prime Minister heads each State government. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: The Chief Minister heads a state.
The Prime Minister heads the Union.
